items.evidence: 1.21.10's ServerLevel constructor takes 11 arguments (MinecraftServer, Executor, LevelStorageAccess, ServerLevelData, ResourceKey, LevelStem, boolean, long, List<CustomSpawner>, boolean, RandomSequences — javap-verified on the 1.21.10 server-game jar); the oracles call the 26.x 10-argument form (no RandomSequences), e.g. VanillaActiveEffectsOracle:36 super(null,null,null,null,null,null,false,0L,List.of(),false). 86 oracles carry the error (45 of the 56 constructor-mismatch first errors on client cp); 23 are single-cause and rescued outright by one mechanical fix (append the RandomSequences argument): VanillaActiveEffectsOracle, VanillaAttributeMapQueriesOracle, VanillaBlockEntityTickerOracle, VanillaBlockEventReadinessOracle, VanillaCombatRulesOracle, VanillaConsumeEffectOracle, VanillaDamageReductionOracle, VanillaEdgeBackoffOracle, VanillaFallDamageOracle, VanillaFoodPropertiesOracle, VanillaGroundStateOracle, VanillaHelmetDamageOracle, VanillaLiveAttributeUpdatesOracle, VanillaLivingDamageOracle, VanillaMovementEmissionOracle, VanillaMovementSupportOracle, VanillaPistonMovementOracle, VanillaRedstonePersistenceOracle, VanillaServerPlayerDamageOracle, VanillaStoredConsumeOracle, VanillaStoredEffectNotificationsOracle, VanillaSwimmingOracle, VanillaWaterSplashOracle. items.evidence: VanillaComponentPatchOracle compiles clean on all three classpaths but will throw ClassNotFoundException at runtime: it does Class.forName("net.minecraft.core.component.Removed") via reflection (line 14) to fetch the Removed.INSTANCE sentinel, and net.minecraft.core.component.Removed has ZERO entries in the 1.21.10 jars (verified by jar listing — it is a 26.x-only class). The 1.21.7 Batch 0 repair for the identical defect (B0-O10, fixed: 1.21.7 DataComponentPatch.map is Reference2ObjectMap<DataComponentType<?>, Optional<?>> with Optional.empty() = removed) is NOT in the 1.21.10 tree. This is the 1.21.7 B0-O10 defect reproducing exactly: a compiling oracle that crashes at runtime. Fix direction (follow-up, not this batch): adopt the 1.21.7 Optional.empty() form, re-verified against 1.21.10's DataComponentPatch (javap the map field type first — do not assume the 1.21.7 form).
items.title: ComponentPatch oracle runtime crash: 26.x-only Removed class via reflection

systemic_note: Same root cause as the pilot's G1/G3/G5/G6, two API steps further back: the 1.21.10 tree carries 26.3 API forms (packages, constructors, abstract methods, holder classes) for things that do not exist in vanilla 1.21.10, and every such reference fails loudly at javac time in the oracles (unlike the port code, where the same pattern silently degrades). New vs the 26.x runs: the 1.21.11-era package moves (GameRules, entity sub-packages, permissions, gizmos, world.attribute) and the 11-arg ServerLevel constructor — the oracle sources sit two API steps ahead of the jar, not one. The 1.21.7 sweep's repairs are not in this tree and must be re-derived for 1.21.10 (11-arg ServerLevel, not 12-arg).
